content: Task ledger update: Hermes Agent gateway receipt adapter and runbook implemented. Added config/hermes_agent_gateway_annunimas.example.yaml, docs/operations/hermes-agent-discord-gateway-runbook.md, and the annunimas-cli utility hermes-agent-gateway-receipt dry-run/write adapter. The adapter turns Hermes Agent Discord/background results into durable HERMES gateway/subagent receipts while preserving the policy boundary that gateway output is evidence, not approval. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-cli -p annunimas-hermes; cargo test -p annunimas-cli hermes_agent_gateway_receipt -- --nocapture; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; dry-run receipt command.
